name: gcse-dashboard
description: One revision dashboard for AQA GCSE Maths and English Language

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,maths,english -c blue,magenta,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w clients/maths" "npm run dev -w clients/english"
scripts.build: npm run build -w clients/maths && npm run build -w clients/english
